Emergency Heating & Furnace Repair in Chesapeake, VA

Whether your home heats with a gas furnace or an electric heat pump, Russell’s American Mechanical answers emergency heating calls in Chesapeake around the clock. Our phone lines run 24/7, and our licensed HVAC technicians handle furnace malfunctions, boiler issues, heat pump failures, and thermostat problems. 

Hampton Roads winters are short, which means heating systems sit idle for months and then get asked to perform on the first hard freeze. That is exactly when hidden failures surface, and it is when our team is staffed to respond with the next available service window. 

Call Us for Heating Solutions

Don’t let heating problems leave you in the cold. Call Russell’s American Mechanical for dependable emergency heating services in Norfolk, VA, and the surrounding areas. Our team is available 24/7 by phone with a guaranteed response time within 24 hours.


Reliable Heating Services for Norfolk and the Greater Area

Contact Russell’s American Mechanical Today

What counts as a heating emergency?

No heat during freezing temperatures, a gas odor near the furnace, a carbon monoxide alarm, or a system making burning smells all qualify. Gas odors and CO alarms mean leaving the home first and calling from outside.

What should I check before calling for emergency heating repair?

Confirm the thermostat is set to heat and above room temperature, check the furnace breaker and the switch beside the unit, and look at the filter, since a fully clogged filter can shut a system down on safety limits. If those check out, the failure needs a technician.

Why do furnaces fail on the first cold day of the year?

Months of inactivity are hard on ignition components, and dust settled over the off-season burns off or interferes on first fire. The first sustained call for heat is the first real test the system has faced since spring, so weak parts fail on day one.

Do you handle heat pump emergencies as well as furnaces?

Yes. A heat pump iced over solid, stuck in defrost, or running only on expensive auxiliary heat is as much an emergency as a dead furnace, and our technicians service both system types.

How quickly can you get to my home?

We schedule emergency calls into the next available service window and prioritize dispatch during cold snaps. Same-day service is the goal on every call, and if we cannot provide it, your service call fee is waived.
